title: source-adapter
description: What a source adapter's changes(cursor) answers to `knowledge update`. An adapter has a name (the --source value), a source (a stable name of the one source it reads, which keys its cursor in the index) and changes(cursor). The update checks each item again on its own; an item that fails is rejected, never indexed. Only an answer with complete true turns a record missing from `items` into a tombstone. An adapter reads its source only: it never writes the index.

cursor.description: What to hand back next time; the index keeps it per source.

skipped.description: Entries of the source that yield no item, and why (null when the adapter keeps no such list). The record `id` of each (null when there is none) leaves the index as rejected.
